declarationEffect: Descriptive metadata only; it does not grant runtime permissions, enforce access, or constitute approval.

tenantDiscovery.identity: Cloud ID validated for the selected site

credentialBoundary.authentication: HTTP Basic from configured email and token; the REST transport requires matching expected/configured site origins and an HTTPS API base bound to the Cloud ID before sending
secretHandling: Never print or log token values or Authorization headers
Do not forward Authorization to signed attachment download redirects

authorizationBoundary.read: Explicit connection checks verify selected-site identity and successful space/page reads; Pull is read-only
authorizationBoundary.write: Push requires authorization.schema.json matching plan SHA-256, operation ID, site origin, Cloud ID, approved actions, and approval evidence reference
authorizationBoundary.syncState: Advance only after required page/version/body and applicable attachment readback is confirmed

deterministicTestAdapter.injection: WireInvoker scriptblock for New-ConfluenceReadInvoker and New-ConfluenceOperationInvoker
deterministicTestAdapter.network: In-memory request/response fakes use synthetic credentials
